description: ⚠️⚠️ a recipe carries a priority Zod does not accept: it installs with one click that answers «could not add that rule», and nothing says which of the eight is broken
⚠️ a condition names a field the rule builder cannot show: the recipe installs, and the rule it wrote cannot be opened and edited afterwards
a recipe fires on a schedule: node-cron does not start on Workers, so it would do nothing at all on that deployment and say nothing about it
two recipes share an id: installing one installs the other, and the dialog marks the wrong one as added
